name: ZIP Creator
description: Bundle any selection of files into a single .zip archive right in your browser, with optional per-file name edits.

howto: Name your archive (the .zip is appended automatically if missing).
Drop files or a whole folder onto the dropzone.
Review the file list on the right — folder paths are preserved.
Your .zip downloads immediately, ready to share or upload.
features: Bundle any number of files into one ZIP
Folder structure preserved inside the archive

faq.q: Do the files get uploaded anywhere?
faq.a: No. Everything is processed locally with the File API and JSZip, then the ZIP is created in your browser.

faq.q: Can I add files from different folders?
faq.a: Yes. Drop multiple selections or folders — each keeps its own path inside the archive.
JSZip with DEFLATE level 6, a good balance of size and speed for typical file bundles.

faq.q: Are there limits on file count or size?
faq.a: It depends on your browser and device memory. Very large batches work but may take longer to compress.
